name: rippletide
description: Local Jev selects session tools; the patched Codex host supplies arguments and execution.

interface.shortDescription: Select Codex tools with the local Jev model.
interface.longDescription: The patched Codex host sends context, request, and all callable session tools to the local scorer, then exposes only the selected tool for argument generation and execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Rippletide to help investigate this project.
